lakshana.deva: यस्याः प्रथमे पादे द्वादशमात्रस्तथा तृतीयेऽपि। अष्टादश द्वितीये चतुर्थके पञ्चदश साऽऽर्या॥
lakshana.iast: yasyāḥ prathame pāde dvādaśamātrastathā tṛtīye'pi. aṣṭādaśa dvitīye caturthake pañcadaśa sā''ryā..
lakshana.iso: yasyāḥ prathamē pādē dvādaśamātrastathā tr̥tīyē’pi. aṣṭādaśa dvitīyē caturthakē pañcadaśa sā’’ryā..
lakshana.hk: yasyAH prathame pAde dvAdazamAtrastathA tRtIye'pi. aSTAdaza dvitIye caturthake paJcadaza sA''ryA..
lakshana.slp1: yasyAH praTame pAde dvAdaSamAtrastaTA tftIye'pi. azwAdaSa dvitIye caturTake paYcadaSa sA''ryA..

blurb: Eleven verses in the āryā metre in praise of the Jina, composed by the prolific polymath Haribhadrasūri in a mixed Sanskrit–Prākṛta register known as sama-saṃskṛta-prākṛta. A testament to the classical bilingual literary tradition of Jaina scholarship.
note: This is a sama-saṃskṛta-prākṛta stavana, meaning it can be read in both Saṃskṛta and Prākṛta with the same meaning in both languages.

padas.deva:
अङ्गुलिदलाभिरामं सुरनरनिवहालिकुलसमालीढम्।
देव! तव चरणकमलं नमामि संसारभयहरणम्॥
padas.iast:
aṅgulidalābhirāmaṃ suranaranivahālikulasamālīḍham.
deva! tava caraṇakamalaṃ namāmi saṃsārabhayaharaṇam..
padas.iso:
aṅgulidalābhirāmaṁ suranaranivahālikulasamālīḍham.
dēva! tava caraṇakamalaṁ namāmi saṁsārabhayaharaṇam..
padas.hk:
aGgulidalAbhirAmaM suranaranivahAlikulasamAlIDham.
deva! tava caraNakamalaM namAmi saMsArabhayaharaNam..
padas.slp1:
aNgulidalABirAmaM suranaranivahAlikulasamAlIQam.
deva! tava caraRakamalaM namAmi saMsAraBayaharaRam..

padas.deva:
हरहास-हार-हिमकर-हिम-कुन्द-करेणुधवल! समचित्त!
अकलङ्क! सुकुलसम्भव! भवविरहं देहि मम देव!॥
padas.iast:
harahāsa-hāra-himakara-hima-kunda-kareṇudhavala! samacitta!
akalaṅka! sukulasambhava! bhavavirahaṃ dehi mama deva!..
padas.iso:
harahāsa-hāra-himakara-hima-kunda-karēṇudhavala! samacitta!
akalaṅka! sukulasambhava! bhavavirahaṁ dēhi mama dēva!..
padas.hk:
harahAsa-hAra-himakara-hima-kunda-kareNudhavala! samacitta!
akalaGka! sukulasambhava! bhavavirahaM dehi mama deva!..
padas.slp1:
harahAsa-hAra-himakara-hima-kunda-kareRuDavala! samacitta!
akalaNka! sukulasamBava! BavavirahaM dehi mama deva!..

padas.deva:
एवं संस्कृतवचनैः प्राकृतवचनैश्च सर्वथा साम्यम्।
विदधानैर्विनुतो मे जिनेश्वरो भवतु सुखहेतुः॥
padas.iast:
evaṃ saṃskṛtavacanaiḥ prākṛtavacanaiśca sarvathā sāmyam.
vidadhānairvinuto me jineśvaro bhavatu sukhahetuḥ..
padas.iso:
ēvaṁ saṁskr̥tavacanaiḥ prākr̥tavacanaiśca sarvathā sāmyam.
vidadhānairvinutō mē jinēśvarō bhavatu sukhahētuḥ..
padas.hk:
evaM saMskRtavacanaiH prAkRtavacanaizca sarvathA sAmyam.
vidadhAnairvinuto me jinezvaro bhavatu sukhahetuH..
padas.slp1:
evaM saMskftavacanEH prAkftavacanESca sarvaTA sAmyam.
vidaDAnErvinuto me jineSvaro Bavatu suKahetuH..
